name: Lao PDR Energy Efficient Datacenter Project (government eco datacenter)
notes: Lao PDR's first government-operated eco datacenter completed in Vientiane 2016-11-29 (IIJ release 2016-11-30); registered as first Lao-Japan JCM project, modular design, outside-air cooling. Current operational role needs re-check; government facility, not colocation. Capacity not published.

name: GDMS National Cloud / National Data Center (MTC)
developer: GDMS (Global Digital Management Solutions) with MTC
notes: GDMS vendor pages: 10-year strategic partnership with MTC, operates/enhances one National Data Center and extends National Cloud infrastructure across both National Data Centers; Government Cloud hosted in an MTC-operated government data center facility. Vendor-primary claim (B+), ministry confirmation pending; no public MW/site specs. No AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI/Alibaba/Tencent/Huawei public cloud region exists in Laos (checked 2026-08-12); nearest regions Thailand/Singapore/Malaysia/Hong Kong/China.

name: Unitel Cloud (Star Telecom / Unitel)
notes: Official Unitel Cloud service page (virtual server, cloud security, storage) with contact address Nongbone Road, Phonxay Village, Saysettha District, Vientiane Capital. A for service/address; physical facility specs unpublished (C for facility specs).

name: LaoDC private data center
developer: Lao Data Center (LaoDC / LAO DC IT Sole Co., Ltd.)
notes: LaoDC official page: own data center in Vientiane Capital with redundant fiber/power, diesel generators, solar; hosting/dedicated/virtual servers. Laotian Times 2018-06-26 reports groundbreaking (Hatxaykhao area) as first private data center in Laos. A for operator claim; certification/current customers unverified; VinaHost reseller claims Tier III (C-grade). Capacity not published.

name: MTC National Data Center + Silicon Tech Park green-AI infrastructure / AI SEZ MoU
developer: MTC National Data Center + Silicon Tech Park (Lao) Sole Co., Ltd.
notes: KPL (state news): 2025-05-30 MoU between the National Data Center under MTC and Silicon Tech Park (Lao) for a feasibility study on green-electricity-powered AI infrastructure and a dedicated AI Special Economic Zone of more than 150 ha in the Vientiane capital area. Pipeline/MoU only; no site, capacity, or operator confirmed.

name: National Data Centre & Government Data Exchange System (feasibility)
developer: MTC + Phounphonnakhone Co., Ltd. (LA Group / Phongsavanh Group)
notes: Vientiane Times and Xinhua (2025-06-27): MTC moving forward with National Data Centre and Government Data Exchange System feasibility study partnering with Phounphonnakhone Co., Ltd. (IT company under LA Group/Phongsavanh Group). Feasibility/pipeline; likely Vientiane, no public site or operator.

name: LANIC National Data Center / government hosting
developer: LANIC (Lao National Internet Center) under MTC
notes: LANIC (Saylom Village, Chanthabouly District, Vientiane Capital) lists National Data Center among main services (APTLD presentation); Retail News Asia reports LANIC hosts a Telekom Malaysia POP via its international data center in Vientiane. A for service/existence; facility specs not public (C for specs).

name: Lao Telecom / ETL / T-Plus internal telecom server rooms
notes: Telecom-internal server-room leads; no public facility-level DC specs found for Lao Telecom/ETL/T-Plus. Inflect directory lists an 'Enterprise of Telecommunications Lao' datacenter building on Saylom Road, Vientiane Capital (C-grade directory lead only).
